C-STATUS-TEST-TIMEOUT-1-E7DA46E8.Problem: **The CI failure, measured.** GitHub run `35017776037` (the push of PR #100 to `main`) failed the `validate` step in `src/grace-status.test.ts:1131` — `it("live repo reports measured reRatificationCount table, both keys as numbers, and measured chain depths")` — with `(fail) … [30230.55ms]` and `^ this test timed out after 30000ms.` (`gh run view 35017776037 --log-failed | grep -E 'timed out|reRatificationCount'`). The test calls `collectProjectStatus(REPO_ROOT)` over the whole archive (**106** directories) and carries no explicit timeout (`grep -c '}, [0-9_]*);' src/grace-status.test.ts` = **0**). Driven locally with a generous timeout it is green: `bun test --timeout=120000 src/grace-status.test.ts -t "live repo reports"` → `1 pass` in `[9811.89ms]` (wall `9.905s`). The rule it violates is already the repository's (`ngrace-spec` `acceptance_criteria_anchors`, `F185`): any test driven against a real repository carries an explicit generous timeout. **The base commit.** Branch `c-teach-copy-drives-lineage` at `aa97022`, the close of `C-TEACH-COPY-DRIVES-LINEAGE-1-B695D12F`; tree clean; `active/` held `.gitkeep` only. Goals.Goal: **The timeout.** `src/grace-status.test.ts`'s `it("live repo reports …")` at line 1131 gains the house explicit generous timeout at its close (`}, 60_000);`, replacing `});`), so the whole-archive walk cannot time out on the 30 s default. The suite stays green and no other line of the file changes.

**The payment.** The plan flushes `F263` (cut at its trailing `---` separator, rendered through the shipped `xmlEscape`) into `docs/plans/active/RM-GOVERNED-PATH/findings.xml` with one index `<Entry id="f263" token="F263" genre="finding" layer="live" />`, and mints the chartered row into `registry.xml` with `<Pays>F263</Pays>`, then runs `--rewrite-roots`. Expected: findings `<Findings base="7529" headroom="267" ceiling="7796">` (the seven-element body), index `<RecordIndex base="269" headroom="27" ceiling="296">`, registry `<Registry base="13" headroom="13" ceiling="26">`, rulings untouched. At the close the authority archives the bundle and runs `--retire`, which moves **two** — `F263` to `findings-retired.xml` stamped `<PaidBy>C-STATUS-TEST-TIMEOUT-1-E7DA46E8</PaidBy>` and the row — and flips the index layer in place; a second `--retire` reports `moved 0`.
